user.title: Controller
user.description: Start in Observe Only mode, review the diagnostic entities, then explicitly turn Observe Only off when the calculations are correct.

energy.title: Energy inputs
energy.description: JG Energy Manager only reads the battery entities. It never writes to AlphaESS in v0.3.3.

data_description.battery_power_entity: Read-only diagnostic input; no AlphaESS command is sent.
data_description.grid_power_entity: Choose the sign convention below so positive is normalised to import.

charger.title: Smart charger
charger.description: Map the Smappee status, power, energy, enable and writable charging-current entities.

data.connected_states: States that mean a vehicle is connected

data_description.charger_status_entity: Select EVCC state, not EVCC charging.
data_description.charger_enable_entity: Select EVCC charging, not Charging state.
data_description.charger_current_entity: Select the Smappee Charging current setpoint, not the fixed Maximum current ceiling.
data_description.charger_energy_entity: Used to measure energy delivered since plug-in.
data_description.connected_states: For the Smappee EVCC state sensor, enter B,C.
data_description.charging_states: For the Smappee EVCC state sensor, enter C,charging. Satisfaction requires a transition out of an active charging state.

data_description.target_energy_kwh: Upper bound for the current plug-in session.
data_description.overnight_battery_floor: The inverter remains responsible for enforcing its own minimum SOC.
data_description.daytime_battery_reserve: Solar charging waits above this reserve, with hysteresis.
data_description.peak_months: 1-12; default matches the seasonal tariff: Jan-Mar, Jun-Aug and Nov-Dec.
data_description.completion_buffer_min: The controller targets completion this many minutes before the ready-by time.

data_description.idle_power_w: Below this power for the timeout, the vehicle is treated as satisfied.
data_description.max_charger_power_w: Hard power cap applied in addition to the maximum current.
data_description.battery_max_charge_power_w: Maximum AlphaESS charging power reserved before sub-reserve solar overflow is offered to the EV.
data_description.grid_tolerance_w: Small grid and battery-power deviations inside this band are ignored to prevent hunting.
data_description.ramp_up_step_a: Maximum current increase after each increase dwell; decreases may occur faster.
data_description.force_charge_current_a: Current requested in Force Charge mode, capped by the configured electrical limits.
data_description.battery_discharge_control_ceiling_w: Maximum battery discharge the controller treats as dependable when deciding whether to hold the 6 A charger minimum.

data.stop_when_disabled: Stop charger when controller is disabled
data.fail_safe_stop: Stop charger when a critical input is invalid
data.initial_observe_only: Default to Observe Only when no runtime state exists

data_description.initial_observe_only: Runtime Observe Only state is controlled by the integration switch and persisted.
data_description.increase_dwell_s: Minimum settling time between current increases.
data_description.decrease_dwell_s: Minimum settling time between current decreases; use 0 for immediate reductions.
data_description.battery_response_grace_s: Maximum time to hold 6 A when measured battery headroom can plausibly absorb the grid import.

secondary.title: Parked second charger
secondary.description: Charger 2 mappings are stored for future use. No active control logic is included in v0.3.3.

data_description.secondary_enabled: Mappings may be retained for diagnostics; Charger 2 remains parked with no automatic control.

error.invalid_connected_states: Enter at least one connected state, for example B,C.
error.invalid_month_list: Use comma-separated month numbers from 1 to 12.
error.secondary_switch_required: Select an on/off switch when the second charger is enabled.
error.invalid_charger_states: Enter at least one connected state and one active charging state.
